owl:Ontology: <http://example.org/university>

dcterms:title: "University and Research Ontology"
dcterms:description: "A synthetic ontology covering people, organizations, places, events, publications, courses, projects and resources -- generated to stress-test gen_drawio.py layout with ~50 classes and a wide variety of relationships."
owl:versionInfo: "1.0"

Legend (Chowlk notation)
box color = class category -- see color key at right for what each color is
blue box = class from another (external) namespace
yellow dashed box = owl:DatatypeProperty
orange dashed box = restriction (hasValue / cardinality)
thick outline = highly-connected "hub" class
hollow triangle arrow = rdfs:subClassOf
solid arrow = object property, domain & range asserted
dashed arrow = object property, domain/range not asserted
filled/hollow circle on arrow tail = only domain / only range asserted
≡ hub = owl:equivalentClass
⧕ hub = owl:intersectionOf, ⧖ hub = owl:unionOf
⊥ hub = owl:AllDisjointClasses / disjointWith
«owl:oneOf» hexagon = enumeration of individuals
